en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a wooded lakeshore or coastal inlet with scattered detached houses. In the foreground, on a small rocky peninsula, stands a striking flat‑roofed, white modernist villa surrounded by trees and a low shoreline wall. A narrow road leads from the villa into a sparsely built residential area with additional villas and forest. No printed captions or handwriting are visible on the image itself.
